steps.name: Resolve supported Pi versions from repository policy
steps.run:
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
policy = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
    [sys.executable, ".github/scripts/pi_promotion.py", "policy"], text=True))
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
    output.write("versions=" + json.dumps(policy["supported_versions"], separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    output.write("last-verified=" + policy["last_verified"] + "\n")

Download this workflow run's exact-host candidates
Assemble the provenance-bound host payload overlay
steps.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(os.environ["CANDIDATE_ROOT"])
REQUIRED_PLATFORMS = {"darwin/amd64", "darwin/arm64", "linux/amd64", "linux/arm64", "windows/amd64", "windows/arm64"}
arguments = [
    sys.executable, "tools/build-host-packages.py",
    "--artifact-stage", os.environ["STAGE_ROOT"],
    "--trusted-source-commit", os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"],
    "--trusted-workflow", ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
    "--trusted-workflow-run", os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"],
]
receipts = sorted(root.glob("artifact-native-*/artifact-qualification.json"))
if len(receipts) != len(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS):
    raise SystemExit(
        f"expected {len(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS)} exact-host receipts, found {len(receipts)}"
    )
candidates = []
observed_platforms = set()
for receipt in receipts:
    candidate = receipt.parent / "artifact-candidate"
    platform_name = json.loads(receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["platform"]
    observed_platforms.add(platform_name)
    candidates.append((platform_name, candidate, receipt))
if observed_platforms != REQUIRED_PLATFORMS:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"expected exact release cohort {sorted(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS)}, "
        f"found {sorted(observed_platforms)}"
    )
for platform_name, candidate, receipt in sorted(candidates):
    arguments.extend(("--artifact-candidate", str(candidate)))
    arguments.extend(("--artifact-qualification", str(receipt)))
for platform_name in sorted(REQUIRED_PLATFORMS):
    arguments.extend(("--require-platform", platform_name))
completed = subprocess.run(
    arguments, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8"
)
result = json.loads(completed.stdout)
with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"]).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
    output.write(
        "promotion-receipt-sha256=" + result["promotion_receipt_sha256"] + "\n"
    )
PY

Acquire reviewed npm@11.19.1 CLI for Pi assembly
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
npm_cli_root="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-cli.XXXXXXXX")"
archive="$npm_cli_root/npm.tgz"
curl --disable --fail --show-error --silent --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 \
  --max-redirs 0 \
  --output "$archive" \
  "https://registry.npmjs.org/npm/-/npm-11.19.1.tgz"
ACTUAL_INTEGRITY="sha512-$(openssl dgst -sha512 -binary "$archive" | openssl base64 -A)"
test "$ACTUAL_INTEGRITY" = "$NPM_CLI_INTEGRITY"
python3 - "$archive" <<'PY'
import pathlib
import sys
import tarfile

with tarfile.open(sys.argv[1], "r:gz") as archive_file:
    for member in archive_file.getmembers():
        path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name)
        if (
            path.is_absolute()
            or ".." in path.parts
            or member.issym()
            or member.islnk()
            or member.isdev()
            or member.isfifo()
        ):
            raise SystemExit(f"unsafe npm CLI archive member: {member.name}")
PY
